convention.name: net-solver
commit_rules: Start with a capitalized imperative verb: Add, Fix, Update, Record, Restructure, Stream, Remove.
Do not use a type prefix such as feat: or fix:, and do not use a scope in parentheses.
Name the concrete thing that changed (file, feature, or document) instead of a vague word like 'stuff' or 'things'.
When the reason is not obvious, add it after 'so' or a semicolon in the same line.
commit_examples: Restructure README around evaluation items 1-5; add study concept book
Stream a keep-alive space every 10s during analysis so idle-timeout middleboxes don't reset it
Add final functional-requirements evidence captured before cleanup
convention.pr_title_format: <Imperative verb> <what changed> (same style as commit titles)
pr_rules: Write in a plain, factual tone. No marketing words.
In How to Test, prefer commands that run locally without an API key (for example: npm run dev, then the example problem).
pr_checklist: nginx.conf and server.js limits are still in sync
No secrets or .env values in the diff
